description_en: Deletes a web filtering template. Deleting a template also deletes all web filtering rules within the template. A template cannot be deleted if it is referenced by an access control policy
description_zh: 删除Web过滤模板。删除模板会同时删除模板内的全部Web过滤规则。模板被访问控制策略引用时无法删除
name: DeleteWebFilterTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the web filtering template to delete. This parameter is required. If you leave this parameter empty, a parameter fault is returned. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account. A template cannot be deleted if it is referenced by an access control policy of the Internet border, NAT firewalls, or virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的Web过滤模板ID，实际必填，传空会返回参数错误。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板。模板被互联网、NAT或VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略引用时无法删除
parameters.name: web_filter_template_id
